name: NituLabs AI Content Fixer – Smart AI to Boost Your Content Quality
author: NituLabs

sections.description:
NituLabs AI Content Fixer is your site’s personal elite editor. It scans your WordPress posts and pages to identify low-quality, thin, or generic content and provides high-authority, human-like rewrites using the world’s most powerful AI models.

🧠 Tired of thin content dragging your SEO down?
✨ Scan your site for free, identify the gaps, and let our Elite AI fix them in one click.

Whether you’re a blogger, SEO specialist, or agency, NituLabs AI Content Fixer helps you transform “Medium” or “Weak” content into “Strong,” high-authority articles that search engines and readers love.

🔥 What’s New in v1.3.0:

  • 👤 Guest Mode: Start scanning your content for free instantly without an API key or registration.
  • 📊 Visual Usage Tracking: New real-time progress bars in the settings page to track your scans and fixes.
  • 📈 Sustainable Pro Tiers: Optimized pricing and limits for Pro users to ensure long-term reliability and deep AI processing.
  • 🔒 Enhanced Security: Added validation to ensure free scans are performed on live HTTPS domains.
  • ⚡ Performance Boost: Switched to high-speed AI processing for even faster content scans.
  • 🔗 Easy Upgrades: Direct upgrade links added to usage limit notifications for a seamless experience.

🌟 No technical skills required. Scan → Identify → Upgrade → Fix!

Features

🎯 Free Site-Wide Scanner – Find every weak post on your site without spending a dime.
✍️ Elite GPT-4o Powered Fixes (PRO) – Professional, high-authority rewrites that add depth and expertise.
🛠️ One-Click Bulk Actions (PRO) – Scan or fix multiple posts simultaneously to save time.
🎭 Intelligent Tone Selection – Tailor your content’s voice (Professional, Creative, SEO, Formal).
📏 Custom Content Length – Generate everything from quick snippets to 2000+ word deep-dives.
🧩 Shortcode & Media Protection – Our AI is trained to never break your images, links, or WordPress shortcodes.
🔐 Secure & Private – Your data is processed securely and never stored on our servers.

Support

For premium support, Pro users can contact us directly via their account dashboard. Free users can visit our support forum.

🪄 NituLabs AI Content Fixer: Don’t just fix content, dominate your niche.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP from your account or WordPress.org.
  2. In WordPress admin, go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. (Optional) Go to the AI Content Fixer menu and enter your API key from nitulabs.com for Pro features.
  5. Start scanning your site for free!
sections.faq:
Is the scanner really free?

Yes! You can perform up to 3 guest scans without any registration. Registered Pro users get higher limits based on their chosen plan.

Why should I upgrade to Pro?

The Pro version unlocks the “Fix” functionality, which uses the Advanced GPT-4o model. It also enables Bulk Fixing, higher scan limits, and advanced Tone/Mode controls.

Will the AI break my Elementor layout?

No. We have implemented strict structural rules and specialized encoding to ensure your shortcodes, images, and layout blocks remain 100% intact.

Does this improve my SEO?

Yes. By transforming “Thin” or “Generic” content into “Strong,” expert-level articles with proper H2/H3 structure and LSI keyword integration, you significantly improve your ranking potential.
sections.changelog:
1.3.0

  • Added Guest Mode (scan up to 3 posts without an API key).
  • Added visual usage progress bars to the settings page.
  • Added localhost and non-HTTPS restrictions for free scans.
  • Added direct “Upgrade Now” links to all usage limit error messages.
  • Fixed a “Division by Zero” critical error for new free users.
  • Optimized Pro tier limits and pricing for better performance.
  • Aligned free usage limits to 3 scans per site.

1.2.0

  • Switched to “Scan for Free, Pay to Fix” model.
  • Added Bulk Scan functionality.
  • Added Bulk Fix (PRO) functionality.
  • Added Tone/Mode selection (Professional, Creative, SEO, Formal).
  • Added WordPress Dashboard Widget for site quality overview.
  • Added “AI Quality” column to Post/Page lists.
  • Improved Elementor & Gutenberg compatibility.
  • Streamlined settings with AJAX validation and Quick Start Guide.

1.1.2

Compatibility check for WordPress 6.9

1.1.0

Introduced customizable content length options.
